rootCause.summary: The violated invariant is enforced incompletely at the recorded root control. notifySpaceDeleted authenticates a JWT using only its issuer, audience, lxm, jti, and time claims. The handler then accepts any request-body SpaceURI whose authority equals the JWT issuer; neither the token nor verifier binds the JWT to the body space. The same valid Bearer token can therefore be paired with a different space URI under the same authority. The selected local audience database records a terminal recipient tombstone for that request-selected space and deletes its outbox rows atomically. Receipt uniqueness includes space_uri, so reusing the same issuer/JTI against another space is not treated as a duplicate. Signature verification, method binding, recipient binding, authority equality, and local-account preopening are strong controls, but none supplies the missing per-space authorization context.
